text: In a village called Sithapur, there lived a poor farmer named Ramu. His only possessions were a small heart, a single ox and a small plot of land. He tilled the land with diligence, but a lack of rain and a debt owed by S Dhalal made life difficult for him. One day, Rau and his wife were talking at night. We worked hard this time too. But the harvest wasn't good. I can't understand how I'll repay S Dhanal's debt. I can't even sleep thinking about it. Radha, tell me what should I do now? >> Have faith in God. God's house is delayed but not unfair. We will surely reap the rewards of our hard work. Why don't you ask Sage Gi for some more time? >> Seth Dhanal doesn't want time anymore. He wants money. His greed disregards anyone. He tied an old man to a tree and usurped all his land for money. Radha, I'm always afraid that Seth Dhanal might take away our land. >> While talking, Rau and Radha didn't even realize when the night passed. The next morning, Sait Dhanal was sitting in his mansion talking with his accountant. The loan that Rau Farmer took out has now expired. Go and tell him tomorrow to either return the money or give up his farm. Sir, he is poor. Give him a little more time. By the time the next crop comes, you will still get your interest, which will keep him burdened under your debt, and your loan amount will also continue to burden under your debt. Haha. [laughter] These poor people keep asking for more time but never talk about repaying the loan. Go and tell him my message clearly. >> Rau was working in his field under the scorching sun when Dhanal said accountant arrived. >> Rau sir has said that you must repay his money by tomorrow otherwise your field will be [music] taken away from you. But I have nothing with me right now. Please give me a little more time so that I can repay Sith G's loan. >> No one can change Seth G's decision now. Arrange the money by tomorrow or be ready to leave the field. >> Saying this, Sage G's accountant left from there. Rau sat down right there in sadness. The despair on his face was clearly visible. Oh god, what kind of test are you putting me through? It would be better if I took poison and gave up my life. >> Saying this, Rau went back to his home. >> Oh, what happened? Why do you look so

worried? Did Seth G say something again today? >> What should I tell you, Radha? The accountant came to the field today and said that if Sith G doesn't get his money by tomorrow, he will take away our land. Now you tell me what should I do? >> Why don't you talk to the villagers? Maybe they could help us a little. >> All right, Roda, I will try this as well. Brothers, can anyone help me? Seth Donal wants to take away my field. Rau, we ourselves are poor. We already have enough troubles of our own. It's not easy at all to fight against Seth Dunl. He is very powerful and many villagers lands are also mortgaged with him. No one has ever managed to get their land back from Seth Dunl till today and you're asking us to go and talk to him. >> Tears welled up in Ramu's eyes and he wondered what he should do now. accountant. If Rau fails to repay the loan on time, his field will be ours anyway. But remember, he should feel that all this is his fate, not my cleverness. >> This isn't right. Poor Rau is already suffering. >> In this world, only the powerful win. There is no place left for the weak anywhere. >> Rau sitting sadly won't solve anything. Go and meet the Mahatma Gi of the village. He has solved people's problems many times before. >> Yes, you are right. I will go to him right now. >> Rau sets out to meet Mahatma Gi. When he reaches there, he tells Mahatma Gi his entire story. >> Mahatma Gi, Sat Dhanal wants to take away all my land. I am very troubled. Please help me Mahatma Gi. Rau, don't worry. In difficult times, one must act with patience and cleverness. I have never seen a man like Seth Donal. First, he gives money to the poor as a loan, and later he takes advantage of their helplessness and grabs their land. But Mahatma Gi, what should I do now? Please show me a way otherwise I will end my life. Rau, your honesty and hard work are your true strength. Turn Seth's greed into his weakness. First unite the villagers and then stand against Seth. >> After talking to Mahatma Gi, Rau comes to the village square to speak with the villagers. Brothers and sisters, if Seth takes my field today, then tomorrow he will come

to take someone else's field. Yes, Rau, you are right. If we all stand together against Seth, only then will Danal understand. But Seth has money and power. He can harm us. >> If we keep being afraid, he will always dominate us. Now we must raise our voice. >> One of Sat's men was standing behind them listening to everything. He went and told Sate all of it. When Sate realized that the whole village was turning against him, he became worried and spoke to his accountant. >> So accountant, farmer Rau is trying to provoke people against me. We must stop him somehow. Sir, if you give Rau a little more time, the situation might calm down. >> No, I want to show the villagers what it means to fight against me. Go and give him the order to vacate the field by tomorrow. >> If we want to defeat Seth, we must do something that exposes his true face in front of everyone. To trap Seth in his own net, use his weakness, his greed. This task will be a bit risky, but if we all do it together, we will surely succeed. >> All the villagers gathered at the village square and were waiting for Sate. After some time, Sate arrived there with great pomp and show. >> Oh ho ho, look at this. Rau, you've gathered all the villagers here. But remember this as well. Not repaying my loan means you will lose your field. Sir, we will agree to what you say. But first, one thing must be decided. If I repay your money, then you must swear that you will never make any claim on my land again. Oh yes. Yes. If you repay my loan, I will not claim your land. But that will never happen because poor people like you only know how to talk. >> The next day, Rau goes to Sate and says to Dhalalate, >> "Sir, I am ready to give you half of the money right now. But I have one condition. I will repay the remaining amount by selling you my crop. If my crop turns out better than expected, then you must return my land to me." Your crop? Your land has already become barren. Fine, I accept your condition. But if the crop turns out bad, then along with your land, you will also have to give me your bullet cart. All right, Seth G, I agree. >> Saying this, Rau returns home. All the villagers come together to help him. Some bring seeds, others bring

fertilizer. Rau starts working day and night in his field. Mahatma Gi and the village head assist Rau at every step. >> If Rau succeeds, Sat will realize the extent of his own power and arrogance. >> Rau is trying to grow his crop. But before the rain comes, I will have his field set on fire. >> Sir, this is not right. If the villagers find out, they will turn against you. Just do as I say otherwise I'll stop letting you eat at my house for free. Understand? >> In the darkness of night s Dhanal sends his men to Ramu's field to set it on fire. But Mahatma Gi senses all of this beforehand. >> I feel that Seth Danal is not going to give up. Therefore, we will have to guard Ramu's field throughout the night. Hearing Mahatma G's words, some villagers begin guarding Ramu's field. Seth's men tried to set the field on fire, but because of the villagers vigilance, their conspiracy fails. >> Look, these are Seth's men. Catch them. Please forgive us. Seth G had sent us here. >> The next morning, all the villagers gather at the village square and S Dhanal is called there. Seth G, what are we hearing? You are plotting such a wicked scheme to destroy Ramu's hard work and our unity. >> No, no, this is a lie. I haven't done anything. >> Seth G, your men have already confessed the truth. >> All the villagers turn against Sate and for the first time he realizes his cunning has failed. After many months, Rau's crop begins to flourish. Accountant G if the price of the crop is lowered in the market, Rau and other farmers like him will have a lot of difficulty repaying their loans. >> Sir, this plan is very dangerous. If people find out, your business and your reputation will be ruined. >> I don't care. I can sacrifice others just to protect my reputation. To sell our crop at a higher price, we must contact the traders in the nearby villages and towns directly, relying on Seth's market is no longer right. If this plan succeeds, Seth's control will weaken. >> Hearing Mahatma G's words, the villagers collectively prepare their bulaks and set out to sell the crop in another village. S Dhan Nalalal receives news that Rau and the villagers are planning to sell their crop outside his control. Then Sate again sends his men to try to stop Rau and the villagers. As the villagers set out with the crop, Sat's men try to block their path along the way.

>> This crop will stop right here. It is Seth G's order. If anyone moves forward, he will be punished with death. This is the fruit of our hard work and we will sell it no matter what. >> The villagers ignore the threats of Sat's men and move forward. Seeing their courage, S's men retreat. Rau and the villagers successfully sell the crop in the city at a high price. And then Rau repays all of Sate's loan as well. >> Now my land is saved and our village has also gained freedom from Seth's control. All this was made possible because of our unity.
